Edit.description: a value being changed where it stands (@yaks/ux Edit), on an entity of its own whose eid is derived from its owner and the value: open while it is, and what its picker searches for; what is typed over it is the person's draft, kept where the host says (its drafts)

open.description: being changed: typed over in place, or its picker floating beside it

query.description: what is typed in its picker's search

Stack.description: panes stacked as a person goes (@yaks/ux Stack), on an entity of its own whose eid is derived from its owner: the panes, bottom first, each the key its owner draws it by; those under the top one show as strips

panes.description: the panes, bottom first, the top one last

Refused.description: an event an Edit emits on the entity whose value it changes: what was typed could not be read as the value's type

caret.description: where the caret stands, as an offset into what is typed

from.description: where the word being completed starts

to.description: where the word being completed ends

cands.description: what can replace the span, each its text and the note shown beside it

pick.description: which of cands is picked, -1 for none: what is typed already reads whole

Completion.description: Completion at a caret, in the host page graph: the replacement span and choices. Text is the host-owned durable draft, not this component.
